cells.name: S. cerevisiae
cells.note: Eukaryote. Crabtree positive: ferments to ethanol even with O2 when glucose is in excess.

reactions.name: Glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: sce@g3p_c + sce@nad_c + sce@pi_c <=> sce@13dpg_c + sce@h_c + sce@nadh_c

reactions.name: Acetaldehyde dehydrogenase (NAD)
reactions.equation: sce@acald_c + sce@h2o_c + sce@nad_c --> sce@ac_c + 2 sce@h_c + sce@nadh_c

reactions.name: Acetaldehyde dehydrogenase (NADP)
reactions.equation: sce@acald_c + sce@h2o_c + sce@nadp_c --> sce@ac_c + 2 sce@h_c + sce@nadph_c

reactions.name: Acetyl-CoA synthetase (PDH bypass)
reactions.equation: sce@ac_c + sce@atp_c + sce@coa_c --> sce@accoa_c + sce@amp_c + sce@ppi_c

reactions.name: Cytosolic citrate synthase (Cit2)
reactions.equation: sce@accoa_c + sce@h2o_c + sce@oaa_c --> sce@cit_c + sce@coa_c + sce@h_c

reactions.name: Malate synthase (Mls1)
reactions.equation: sce@accoa_c + sce@glx_c + sce@h2o_c --> sce@coa_c + sce@h_c + sce@mal__L_c

reactions.name: Pyruvate carboxylase
reactions.equation: sce@atp_c + sce@hco3_c + sce@pyr_c --> sce@adp_c + sce@h_c + sce@oaa_c + sce@pi_c

reactions.name: Glutamate dehydrogenase (NADP)
reactions.equation: sce@glu__L_c + sce@h2o_c + sce@nadp_c <=> sce@akg_c + sce@h_c + sce@nadph_c + sce@nh4_c

reactions.name: Glutamina sintetasa
reactions.equation: sce@atp_c + sce@glu__L_c + sce@nh4_c --> sce@adp_c + sce@gln__L_c + sce@h_c + sce@pi_c

reactions.name: Biomass (yeast core, with GAM)
reactions.equation: 1.24 sce@3pg_c + 2.91 sce@accoa_c + 52 sce@atp_c + 0.32 sce@e4p_c + 0.15 sce@f6p_c + 0.13 sce@g3p_c + 0.3 sce@g6p_c + 0.25 sce@gln__L_c + 4.2 sce@glu__L_c + 52 sce@h2o_c + 3.1 sce@nad_c + 11.5 sce@nadph_c + 1.5 sce@oaa_c + 0.52 sce@pep_c + 2.5 sce@pyr_c + 0.9 sce@r5p_c --> 52 sce@adp_c + 3.6 sce@akg_c + 2.91 sce@coa_c + 52 sce@h_c + 3.1 sce@nadh_c + 11.5 sce@nadp_c + 52 sce@pi_c

reactions.name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase complex
reactions.equation: sce@coa_m + sce@nad_m + sce@pyr_m --> sce@accoa_m + sce@co2_m + sce@nadh_m

reactions.name: Citrate synthase
reactions.equation: sce@accoa_m + sce@h2o_m + sce@oaa_m --> sce@cit_m + sce@coa_m + sce@h_m

reactions.name: 2-Oxoglutarate dehydrogenase
reactions.equation: sce@akg_m + sce@coa_m + sce@nad_m --> sce@co2_m + sce@nadh_m + sce@succoa_m

reactions.name: Succinyl-CoA synthetase
reactions.equation: sce@atp_m + sce@coa_m + sce@succ_m <=> sce@adp_m + sce@pi_m + sce@succoa_m

reactions.name: Mitochondrial ATP synthase
reactions.equation: sce@adp_m + sce@pi_m + 3 sce@h_im --> sce@atp_m + sce@h2o_m + 2 sce@h_m

reactions.name: bc1 + cytochrome c oxidase (pumps H+ into the intermembrane space)
reactions.equation: sce@q6h2_m + 0.5 sce@o2_m + 4 sce@h_m --> sce@q6_m + sce@h2o_m + 4 sce@h_im

reactions.name: Internal NADH dehydrogenase Ndi1 (does not pump H+)

texts.text: NADPH and pentoses; the carbon returns as F6P and G3P
ATP spent on the gradient and upkeep
NADH to O2 pumps H+ out of the matrix
